entries.name: Iron Damage Doctrine V
entries.text: Ironsides. Mandatory per Amya; can replace with Epic Leadership Doctrine.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: if you can help your unit (heavy armor, or fighting medium armor) go Top Line + rest Mid until 3/3 piercing dmg, rest non-selected line; if you can't help your unit (light armor, or medium such as musket) go Bot Line + rest Mid until 3/3 piercing dmg, rest non-selected line. Hero pairing: Any. Playstyle kit: relies heavily on Cover Commander as main DPS tool (mini-charge CD 9s, not the first ability); focus charge-related doctrines especially +1 hit on charge; always use Cover Commander mode, never V; can charge to engage but better to activate Cover Commander and move in/out of combat; triggering Charge then Cover Commander (no V/X-move) stacks a mini-charge on next impact; reset Cover Commander every ~2s for the hidden damage-reduction passive (40%->0%, decaying 4-6s). Example build: Stamina Doctrine V, Charge Doctrine V, Iron Damage Doctrine V (or Epic Leadership Doctrine), Unit Damage Doctrine V or Siege Fighter Doctrine, Anti-Infantry Doctrine or Noble Blood Doctrine. "Don't put" section is a literal X placeholder in the OP — not fabricated here. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset — Men-at-Arms is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
